findings.title: Producer admits authored strings beginning U+FEFF that native composition deterministically refuses
findings.requirement: Composition register lines11,20 and wire lines30,34: deterministic producer-known invalid material must be rejected before inserts/reservation; API and native must agree on complete payload grammar.
steps: Create a fresh two-package seed entirely under owned scratch.
Prefix the published-procedure source objective string with U+FEFF inside its JSON document (not a BOM at file start); keep all package digests rebuilt from source.
Run real compile_catalog, capture, prepare_packages, DTO parsing, managed_contract.build_records and managed_composition.stage_payload.
Feed the resulting complete wire unchanged to native.validate_stage; contrast the ordinary seed through the same producer/native functions.
findings.observed: Ordinary positive accepted by API/native (17005 bytes). Leading-U+FEFF objective compiled and prepared, API built complete graph and stage payload successfully (17014 bytes), then native refused ValueError: Invalid native preparation. No envelope corruption or re-sealing post-producer was necessary.
findings.cause: API _authored_text rejects C0/C1 controls but not a leading U+FEFF per authored string. Native authored() calls raw_text() for every string; raw_text also rejects startswith(U+FEFF). Package-level preparation only sees file-level text and therefore does not reject an embedded objective.
findings.impact: Producer emits deterministic native-inadmissible material. Owner ordering commits dispatch reservation before RuntimeClient invokes native validation, so such a selected recipe can fail too late rather than fail at preparation. Late durable/owner effect is inferred from code ordering, NOT claimed measured on PG or installed transport.
findings.remedy: Make API authored-string grammar match native before persistence/reservation (reject leading U+FEFF at each authored scalar, unless both contracts deliberately allow it); keep exact bytes, do not silently strip it. Add real source-producer positive/negative cross-runtime parity regression.
findings.limits: Real source compiler/producer/validator executed; synthetic refs as used by source fixtures. No PG publication/receipt/dispatch lifecycle executed in this review.

findings.title: Editing after unconfirmed readback erases stale protection and enables another POST/PUT
reproduction: Mount real App at /engagements/new or existing /setup with synthetic valid session and draft.
Save valid local values; fetch supplies a successfully decoded POST201 or PUT200 revision receipt.
Fail its confirmation GET with connection loss (realistic fault boundary), or separately decoded BODY_TOO_LARGE/413 (branch-priority negative).
Observe Unconfirmed readback, disabled Save and Retry exact GET readback.
Edit Engagement name. change() changes stale to idle and clears notice; Save becomes enabled and exact GET control disappears.
Click Save. Observed mutation call count is 2, not 1, without successful readback or explicit reconciliation.
findings.expected: Edits must not clear the receipt/readback barrier. No second mutation until exact pending receipt reconciliation; preserve original receipt snapshot if local editing is allowed.
findings.actual: All four POST/PUT x network/413 cases fail the same three assertions on current and BASE: enabled Save, absent exact GET retry, mutation count 2.
findings.impact: Violates explicit requested safety acceptance criterion. POST can duplicate an already-created draft (risk inferred, no DB duplication claimed); PUT reissues against old CAS base rather than reconciling (real backend CAS outcome not exercised).
findings.remedy: Minimal separately owned fix: prevent stale from becoming idle through change, and retain a receipt-bound immutable snapshot for exact readback or gate editing until it confirms. Do not auto-resubmit. Add POST/PUT readback-failure then edit regressions.

reports.scope: Independent source/component re-review of bbe042a..907566d only: preserve receipt barrier through edits, exact explicit GET/conflict/keep-local/new-CAS recovery, unchanged direct BODY_TOO_LARGE refusal and unknown-write safety. Not installed/browser/canonical acceptance.
